name: EmailCapture
usage_hint: Email signup form with validation, loading states, and success feedback — typically used in footer, modal, or dedicated newsletter sections.
when_to_use: For newsletter signups, discount code capture (pair with discount prop), product launch waitlists, or general lead capture. Works inline or nested in a Modal island for exit-intent popups.
when_not_to_use: For complex multi-field forms (name, phone, etc.; use a custom form island). Don't use for transactional email collection at checkout (Shopify handles that).
anti_patterns: Promising a discount without delivering it (set discount prop but no follow-up email; damages trust)
Using inside a Modal without setting showOnce:true on the modal (spams users every page load)
Overly aggressive placement (multiple EmailCapture islands on one page; stick to one primary location)
Generic placeholder text ("Enter your email" is boring; try "Get 10% off your first order" or "Join 10,000+ subscribers")

examples.label: Newsletter signup (footer, default variant)
examples.source:
<lx-island name="EmailCapture">
  <script type="application/json">{"placeholder":"Enter your email for updates","buttonText":"Subscribe","successMessage":"Thanks! Check your inbox to confirm.","variant":"default"}</script>
</lx-island>

examples.label: Discount offer (compact, with discount message)
examples.source:
<lx-island name="EmailCapture">
  <script type="application/json">{"placeholder":"Your email","buttonText":"Get 10% Off","successMessage":"Code sent! Check your email.","discount":"🎉 Get 10% off your first order","variant":"compact"}</script>
</lx-island>

examples.label: Product launch waitlist (default, custom copy)
examples.source:
<lx-island name="EmailCapture">
  <script type="application/json">{"placeholder":"Enter your email to get early access","buttonText":"Join Waitlist","successMessage":"You're on the list! We'll notify you at launch.","variant":"default"}</script>
</lx-island>

examples.label: Exit-intent modal email capture (nested in Modal)
examples.source:
<lx-island name="Modal">
  <script type="application/json">{"trigger":"exit_intent","triggerValue":5000,"position":"center","size":"md","headline":"Wait! Before you go...","body":"Join our newsletter and get 15% off your first order.","showOnce":true,"children":[{"island":"EmailCapture","props":{"placeholder":"Your email address","buttonText":"Claim My Discount","discount":"15% OFF","variant":"compact"}}]}</script>
</lx-island>
